action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that OpenJPEG did not properly handle memory when
encoding image files. An attacker could use this issue to cause OpenJPEG to
crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary
code.
isummary: OpenJPEG could be made to crash or run programs when encoding image files.
title: OpenJPEG vulnerability
